newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates end lower amid loose liquidity.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates end lower amid loose liquidity.

text.p: Taiwan money rates closed lower on Thursday as market liquidity stayed loose on expectation that T$21.7 billion worth of NCDs or bills would enter the banking system in coming days, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate ended at 4.971 percent against Wednesday's 5.000 close, with 30-day commercial paper at 4.95-5.00 percent against 5.00. Dealers expected rates to sink further in the near term.
The bond market saw no transaction in the afternoon. The seven-year 86/3 bond yield was at 5.7575 against 5.7500 after morning trade. -- Julie Hu (5080815)
